column1: # PR4c handoff to PR5 (#10861): the 43 deferred-sweep pairs stay baselined and untouched. NOT YET MEASURED: PR5 measures duration (scripts/suite-durations.tsv) and the 200-PR selection replay per glob at its own work time on current origin/main. No duration or replay number is stored here.

# CTO ruling (decision-challenges.md row 7, 2026-10-26): out of PR4c and PR4d; PR5 owns the policy execution and both measurements; no pair is globbed or added to ALWAYS_ON_SUITES unless both measurements were taken in PR5 and meet the thresholds below, otherwise it stays baselined for an explicit PR5 call.

# Policy text (PR4b row 6, verbatim): Ruled by CTO agent, 2026-10-25: policy recorded now for a later PR to execute, per whole-tree or glob reader: (1) a `glob:` edge if the suite's duration in `scripts/suite-durations.tsv` is 60 s or less and a replay over the last 200 merged PRs selects it in at most 25% of them; (2) `ALWAYS_ON_SUITES` if the glob selects it more often and the suite takes 30 s or less; (3) otherwise the pair stays baselined until a PR5 decision. Accept-with-reason is NEVER used for a real whole-tree reader, only for mentions. The later PR must bring two measurements: per-suite duration from `suite-durations.tsv` and the 200-PR selection-size replay per glob.
